objs.description: Indicates the objects to which the {@link ApplyNewMuteDurationSpec#newMuteDuration} should be applied.

updateAll.description:
Indicates whether all {@link ApplyNewMuteDurationSpec#objs} should be updated
with the specified {@link ApplyNewMuteDurationSpec#newMuteDuration}.

newMuteDuration.description: Indicates the new mute duration to apply to the specified {@link ApplyNewMuteDurationSpec#objs}.

targetTimezone.description: Indicates the {@link TimeZone} to use when interpreting the {@link ApplyNewMuteDurationSpec#newMuteDuration}.

title:
Specification type for muting alerts in the client side.
This type holds all the fields applicable for applying a new mute duration.
name: ApplyNewMuteDurationSpec
